title: Pi Organization Telemetry
description: Axon Pi usage, adoption, cost and reliability. Select All users for the organization view or pick emails for a personal view.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct verified emails that ran an Axon Pi session in the selected range.

panels.title: New users
panels.description: Users active in the range with no session in the 30 days before it.

targets.expr: count(count by (user_email) (count_over_time(pi_session_started_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])) unless count by (user_email) (count_over_time(pi_session_started_total{user_email=~"$user"}[30d] offset $__range))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Pi sessions started (startup, new, resume, fork). Counts short-lived processes too.

panels.title: Interactions
panels.description: Submitted prompts that ran the agent.

panels.title: Estimated cost
panels.description: Pi's cost estimate from provider usage, not billing.

panels.title: Total tokens
panels.description: Inclusive input (uncached + cache read + cache write) plus output. Reasoning is already inside output.

targets.expr: (sum (label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_input_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_read_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_write_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_output_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_output_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_output_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_output_total", "", ""))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Agent hours
panels.description: Wall-clock time the agent spent working on interactions (similar to Claude Code's CLI active time).

targets.expr: (sum ((increase(pi_cost_USD_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_cost_USD_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_cost_USD_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))) / (sum ((increase(pi_session_started_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_session_started_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_session_started_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of input tokens served from the provider prompt cache.

targets.expr: (sum ((increase(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))) / (sum (label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_input_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_read_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_write_total", "", "")))

((sum ((increase(pi_llm_errors_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_llm_errors_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_llm_errors_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / (sum ((increase(pi_llm_requests_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_llm_requests_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_llm_requests_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])))

((sum ((increase(pi_tool_errors_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tool_errors_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tool_errors_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / (sum ((increase(pi_tool_calls_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tool_calls_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tool_calls_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Active users (DAU / WAU / MAU)
panels.description: Distinct users with any Pi session sample in each window. Widen the time range to at least 7 days for weekly/monthly trends.

panels.title: CLI version adoption
panels.description: Users whose first initialized Pi session in the range ran each Axon CLI version.

panels.title: User leaderboard
panels.description: Per-user totals for the selected range, sorted by estimated cost. Click a column header to re-sort.

targets.expr: sum by (user_email) (label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_input_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_read_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_write_total", "", ""))

topk(10, sum by (user_email) (label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_input_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_read_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_write_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_output_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_output_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_output_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_output_total", "", "")))

panels.title: Top repositories by cost
panels.description: Attributed when each session ends, so running sessions appear after they close.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (pi_repo_slug) ((increase(pi_session_cost_USD_sum{user_email=~"$user",pi_repo_slug=~"$repo"}[$__range]) and (pi_session_cost_USD_sum{user_email=~"$user",pi_repo_slug=~"$repo"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_session_cost_USD_sum{user_email=~"$user",pi_repo_slug=~"$repo"}[$__range])))

topk(10, sum by (gen_ai_request_model) ((increase(pi_cost_USD_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_cost_USD_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_cost_USD_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Top sessions by cost
panels.description: One pi.session summary span per finished session (subject to trace sampling). Sort by the cost column; set the minimum with the 'Min session cost' variable.

targets.query: { name = "pi.session" && resource."user.email" =~ "$user" && span."pi.session.cost.usd" >= $min_session_cost } | select(span."pi.session.cost.usd", span."pi.session.tokens.output", span."pi.session.interactions", span."pi.session.duration_s", span."pi.repo.slug", span."session.id", resource."terminal.type")

panels.title: Cost by usage source
panels.description: assistant = main loop, tool = subagents/tool-side LLM work, compaction, branch_summary.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_input_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_read_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_write_total", "", ""))

sum by (gen_ai_request_model) ((increase(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_input_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_input_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_read_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_read_total", "", "") or label_replace((increase(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_cache_write_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]), "metric_source", "pi_tokens_cache_write_total", "", ""))

sum by (gen_ai_request_model) ((increase(pi_cost_USD_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_cost_USD_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_cost_USD_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model) ((increase(pi_llm_requests_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_llm_requests_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_llm_requests_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Requests by reasoning effort
panels.description: Pi thinking level requested for each inference call.

panels.title: Reasoning share of output by model
panels.description: Reasoning tokens as a fraction of output tokens (reasoning is a subset of output).

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model) ((increase(pi_tokens_reasoning_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_reasoning_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_reasoning_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model) ((increase(pi_tokens_output_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tokens_output_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tokens_output_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Sessions by terminal
panels.description: Bounded terminal.type classification (editor, emulator, multiplexer, ssh, or none for scripted use).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (pi_repo_slug) ((increase(pi_session_started_total{user_email=~"$user",pi_repo_slug=~"$repo"}[$__range]) and (pi_session_started_total{user_email=~"$user",pi_repo_slug=~"$repo"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_session_started_total{user_email=~"$user",pi_repo_slug=~"$repo"}[$__range])))

topk(15, sum by (gen_ai_tool_name) ((increase(pi_tool_calls_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range]) and (pi_tool_calls_total{user_email=~"$user"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time(pi_tool_calls_total{user_email=~"$user"}[$__range])))
